correctness.rationale: PASS: Explicit labeled Franklin graph is cubic on 12 vertices with 18 edges, cyclic edges i-(i+1) and alternating long chords. Faces are exactly vertex subsets omitting every closed neighborhood N[v], i.e. complements of dominating sets; independent 4096-mask computation yields 2417 faces including empty, vector by dimension (-1 through 7) (1,12,66,220,483,696,612,276,51). Independent sorted-toggle Morse matching gives 1203 pairs, one critical 0-cell, nine critical 5-cells, with all 2416 nonempty face-poset vertices exhausted by full topological sort; hence integral homotopy wedge 9S5. Independent adjacency-preserving permutation enumeration finds 48 automorphisms, including central shift i→i+6. Direct signed fixed-face Lefschetz sums (the reduced empty-face sign included) give degree-five rational character multiset {-3:6,-1:24,1:9,3:8,9:1}, invariant dimension zero and central trace -1, thus 4+5 central eigenspaces. Inspected exact verifier checks the S4×C2 splitting via a 24-element kernel acting faithfully on its four Sylow-3 subgroups, verifies all 48² products, and yields exactly five distinct S4×C2 irreducibles with multiplicity one as claimed. This does not establish an integral equivariant wedge splitting.
